collocations.en: what it is used for; what use it is

messages.en: What's this thing for? I found it in the drawer just now.
Oh, that's an adapter. If you want to connect a computer to a projector, just use that.

senses.en_definition: A mountain; a large natural elevation of the land, higher and more substantial than a hill.

messages.en: Fancy climbing a mountain this weekend? Let's set off nice and early.
I'm in! Is five in the morning okay? I'll pick you up at your place, then we'll grab breakfast first.

senses.en_definition: A teacher; a person who imparts knowledge or teaches skills.
A Hindu religious teacher or spiritual guide.

messages.en: Who's your kid's class teacher this year? Mine keeps asking which class their friend will be in.
Miss Farah. Your kid's in her class too, right? If they're in the same class, mine will feel a bit better about it—at least they'll have a friend.

senses.en_definition: An exclamation used to taunt or reproach someone suffering the consequences of ignoring a warning.
An exclamation expressing satisfaction or relief.

collocations.en: Ah, here they are at last!

messages.en: I can't find the house keys. Have you seen them?
Try the front pocket of your bag. That's where you put them earlier, isn't it?
Ah, found them! They were tucked under a receipt. Let's go.
